{{Quote|You don't think I can do it? Well, son, that just doubled the fee&hellip;and I tell you what: I'm the ''only'' person in this town who can fix that plasma transvertor. Pay or walk to Coruscant&hellip;it's your choice.|Dom Antyll|<ref name="GG7" />}}
'''Dom Antyll''' was one of the best [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] in all of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He owned [[Docking Bay 92]], which he converted for use in starship repairs. His prices were high, and he tended to raise the price for anyone who questioned his ability, but his work was excellent.<ref name="GG7" />
